name: Buflomedil

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and 3 other countries, first in 2011 — for nerve and brain harm and blood vessel problems

summary: Buflomedil was taken off the market in France and three other countries starting in 2011 because it caused blood vessel damage and harmed the nervous system [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people, estimating a low risk score of 30 for the liver [M]. That same computer model, also not based on human testing, gave the drug a medium risk score of 58 for the heart [M].
